arguments.sql:
SELECT 
    EmployeeID,
    FirstName,
    LastName,
    JobTitle,
    VacationHours,
    FIRST_VALUE(VacationHours) OVER (
        PARTITION BY JobTitle 
        ORDER BY VacationHours ASC
    ) AS MinVacationHoursByTitle
FROM HumanResources.Employee
JOIN Person.Person ON HumanResources.Employee.BusinessEntityID = Person.Person.BusinessEntityID
QUALIFY VacationHours = FIRST_VALUE(VacationHours) OVER (
    PARTITION BY JobTitle 
    ORDER BY VacationHours ASC
);
